label: Clothing State Resolver
instructions: Separate stable clothing items from temporary clothing states.
Use clothingState only for current visible states such as wet clothes, open clothes, torn clothes, bare shoulders, clothes lift.
Current outfit overrides default outfit only when the latest context supports it.

examples.context: 雨水打湿了她的白衬衫。
她穿着黑色和服，肩膀微露。
